metadata.purpose: Observe source notifications and connection lifecycle without replacing successful values.

conditions: Successful notification hooks preserve original payload identity and notification order.
A thrown notification-hook value replaces that notification with an error.
unsubscribe hooks run on cancellation or next-handler failure, not normal source error/complete; finalize runs on all acquired-source termination paths.

scope.parameters: A subset of the six named observer hooks; next-function form is the next-only profile.
scope.callbacks: next/error/complete invocation outcomes are explicit correlated events. subscribe/unsubscribe/finalize are nonthrowing observation actions; their return values have no effect.
scope.time: No clock is introduced. Source events supply time; input order breaks equal-time ties. Callers must supply synchronous callback outcomes at the invocation time; generic runTrace does not enforce that envelope-time precondition.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Throwing lifecycle hooks (subscribe/unsubscribe/finalize), deprecated positional overload parsing and JavaScript receiver binding.
Payload mutation is not simulated: reference identity is preserved, not a deep snapshot.
Source delivery during acquisition and observer-triggered cancellation during a pending callback.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: No connection during construction. The first result subscription applies the profile-specific acquisition rule.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Return from the currently pending, correlated synchronous callback.
Throw from the currently pending, correlated synchronous callback.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Listening.
See the typed state and named transitions for Calling.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.nextState: Listening with next notification invocation index zero.
rules.explanation: The lifecycle hook runs before source acquisition. Neither runs during operator construction.

rules.guard: source is live; matching hook is configured
actions: invoke the matching hook with the source notification payload
rules.nextState: Calling next with the original notification retained; only its correlated outcome is legal.
rules.explanation: The source notification is not forwarded until its handler returns successfully.

rules.guard: return matches the pending next invocation
rules.nextState: Listening; advance invocation index and clear pending notification.
rules.explanation: Handler return values are ignored: tap is not map. Terminal callbacks clear the internal unsubscription flag before being called.

rules.guard: throw matches the pending next invocation
actions: error with the exact thrown value instead of the pending notification
rules.explanation: A next-handler throw terminates by unsubscription, so unsubscribe precedes finalize.

rules.guard: source is live; matching hook is absent
actions: release source and invoke configured finalize hook
rules.explanation: Missing hooks are bypassed; no implicit callback or timing policy is introduced.

rules.guard: source is live; matching hook is absent
actions: release source and invoke configured finalize hook
rules.explanation: Missing hooks are bypassed; no implicit callback or timing policy is introduced.

rules.nextState: Closed cancel; no downstream terminal notification.
rules.explanation: Cancellation and normal source termination have different lifecycle hook policies.
